about: Held-out routing phrasings for the creative skills. Written before measuring and never used to tune aliases or keywords (tune against tests/catalog-routing.test.mjs instead). The first measurement (2026-11-13) was 12/20 top-1: most misses returned no match, which leaves the choice to the agent's own skill descriptions. Gate: top-1 never drops below baselineTop1, and no case confidently routes to a different skill. Raise baselineTop1 only when a change outside this file improves it; never edit cases to make a change pass.
